notes.title: 1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for such an enthusiastic response to Star Wars: Droid Repair Bay!

Fix highlights from the latest patch:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the game could start, but the start game "play button" hologram would remain visible
[*]G2-RX's head movement should now appear more "natural"
[*]Fixed several issues related to localization in regions outside North America
[*]Several optimizations and fixes that should improve performance on all systems (particularly the HTC Vive minimum spec)
[*]Fixed an issue where Steam users were not receiving credit for several achievements rewarded at the end of the experience
[*]Fixed an issue where attempting the achievement "Three Pointer" could cause NR-S3 droids to stop delivering parts
[*]The achievements "Hyperspeed", "Thorough Diagnostician" and "Lightning Reflexes" should now be easier to complete
[/list]
